title: Image Model Conversion
summary: Facilitates the conversion of various image-related models from their original frameworks to the Hugging Face Transformers format.

nodes.label: Vision Model Converters
nodes.title: Vision Model Converters
nodes.description: Converts general vision models like BEiT, ConvNext, DINOv2, EfficientNet, MobileNet, MobileViT, Swin, and ViT from external formats to Hugging Face Transformers models.

nodes.label: Depth and Segmentation Converters
nodes.title: Depth and Segmentation Converters
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of models specialized in depth estimation and semantic/instance segmentation tasks, such as DPT, GLPN, SegGPT, UperNet, VitMatte, and ZoeDepth.

nodes.label: Video Model Converters
nodes.title: Video Model Converters
nodes.description: Converts models designed for video understanding and processing, specifically VideoMAE, into the Hugging Face Transformers format.

nodes.label: Image Restoration Converters
nodes.title: Image Restoration Converters
nodes.description: Focuses on converting models for image restoration tasks, such as super-resolution, exemplified by Swin2SR.

nodes.label: Pose Estimation Converters
nodes.title: Pose Estimation Converters
nodes.description: Converts models for human pose estimation, including VitPose.

groups.label: Image Conversion Core
groups.title: Image Conversion Core Logic
groups.description: Central modules responsible for converting various image-related models from external formats to Hugging Face Transformers.
